_about: Levered equity IRR for a hand-built WEB-FSC-4 case page, computed by scripts/casemodel.py from the case's own inputs (owner ruling of October 16, 2026: the exit at the cap rate the page cites, the method WEB-FSC-4 used for California and Florida). casemodel.py fills the page's case:<slug>.v.* regions; --check fails when the page states anything else. Each input names where the page states it, or why it is an assumption.

bank_pct.basis: page: capital structure, bank first mortgage (50%)

debenture_pct.basis: page: capital structure, CDC / SBA 504 debenture (35%), the New Business tier of 13 CFR 120.910 (page source 20)

equity_pct.basis: page: capital structure, borrower equity injection (15%)

noi.basis: page: debt-service coverage ramp, NOI Years 1 to 3; stabilized NOI held flat after Year 3 (the page's modest growth is not quantified)

exit_cap.basis: assumption: the wide end of the 6.0 to 8.5% range the page cites for dedicated RV and boat storage (page source 18), consistent with its conservative exit

selling_cost.basis: assumption: the page states none; 3% of the gross sale, as WEB-FSC-4 used for California
